title: atoll catalog backup --json
description: A backup of the catalog, beside it in backups/, the oldest past seven removed, and with maintenance.catalog_on_disks a copy on each disk not failed (specs.md §9, §25).

backup.description: The path of the backup: <catalog folder>/backups/catalog-<UTC time, YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>.db.

removed.description: The names of the backups removed, the oldest first.

disks.description: With maintenance.catalog_on_disks, each disk not failed, in configuration order, and whether the backup reached its Atoll/catalog/catalog.db; empty otherwise.
